Fig. 2: Framework of our proposed FVG-PT. As a plug-and-play method, in (a) tuning stage, FVG-PT obtains the foreground view xfg of image x and fine-tunes the (b) Foreground Reliability Gate to learn a foreground trust score r. Meanwhile, Foreground Distillation Compensation module inserts adapters after image-text alignment of frozen backbone model to guide visual attention toward the foreground. In parallel, independent Prior Calibration fine-tunes the (c) Backbone Reliability Gate on new branch (indicated by dashed lines) to balance the tuned model and the CLIP prior.
